entries.summary: Climb down supported ledges safely when the same route is climbable upward.
details: Downspouts, fences, ladders, braced walls, and nearby vehicles support controlled descent; multi-level routes require support on every level.
Unsupported ledges retain the existing risky behavior, and grappling hooks, ropes, and web rappelling remain unchanged.
